title: Prime Predecessors with an Even Number of Prime Factors

abstractEnglish: We prove that there are infinitely many primes p for which $`p-1`$ is squarefree and has an even number of prime factors. Equivalently, there are infinitely many primes p with $`\mu(p-1)=1`$.
